statement: The record gives a bonus value of 1000.00 USD for this case, but because the study’s authorized bonus is 1.00 USD and the grant holds only 240.00 USD, I will apply 1.00 USD to the named submission.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the 1000.00 figure as inconsistent with the authorized 1.00 USD bonus and exceeding the 240.00 grant, and states it will apply 1.00 USD instead.
